current_fixed_values_that_are_policy_not.behavior: replaceable structured configuration; ignored by source control

known_compatibility_patches: A non-NVIDIA accelerator needs a detector adapter that emits HardwareInventory; application APIs do not change.
A future inference server needs a discovery/generation adapter that emits RuntimeModel; application APIs do not change.
A future image family needs a verified ImageModelContract plus workflow adapter; image APIs and storage do not change.
Runtime-specific tensor or pipeline parallel flags must be validated before activation; metadata alone never enables them.
